  PROBLEM: `FILE_RE` and `ID_RE` are `$`-anchored and applied with `.match()` in `file_ok()` and in `not ID_RE.match(finding_id)`, so a model-written `file` or `finding_id` with one trailing newline passes validation and is sent unchanged in the public dispatch.
  WHY: In Python, `$` also matches just before a trailing newline, and only `category` and `severity` are stripped. The intake's `_SYNCED_SECURITY_FILE_RE` and `_SYNCED_SECURITY_FINDING_ID_RE` (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py lines 118-119) use the same anchor, so the newline reaches fingerprints, issue lines, markers and the Markdown table row in the public heal issue. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and openai_gpt-6-luna said NIT, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite gave none; NIT is mapped to the lowest allowed level, low. Suggested fix: `fullmatch()` or anchor with `\Z`.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/security_audit_upstream_report.sh:the embedded selector, `FILE_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9._/+-]{1,300}$")` and `ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,80}$")`. They are applied with `.match()` in `file_ok()` and in `not ID_RE.match(finding_id)`. | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `$` matches before a single trailing newline, so `"file": ".claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py\n"` or `"finding_id": "guard-bypass-0\n"` passes. Neither value is stripped, and the `..` and empty-part check passes because the newline stays inside the last path part. The value is copied into `selected[...]["file"]` / `["finding_id"]` and dispatched. The intake's `_SYNCED_SECURITY_FILE_RE` and `_SYNCED_SECURITY_FINDING_ID_RE` (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py lines 118-119) have the same anchor.
  WHY: Model-controlled text can carry a newline into the coding-workflows report and into any fingerprint, issue line or marker built from `file` or `finding_id`. This breaks the six-safe-fields promise. The reviewer calls it hardening, not a crash.
  HARDENING: use `FILE_RE.fullmatch(value)` and `ID_RE.fullmatch(finding_id)`, or anchor both with `\Z`. Fix the workflow_failure_heal.py regexes in a follow-up, because that file is outside this PR's grant. About 2 lines changed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  NOTE: All other categories are NONE. The reviewer verified `normalize_category` canonicalization, the widened regexes, the `heal_switch` default under `set -u`, the stale-export test fix, the workflow-step gating, and that every deliverable is present.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
